Name: (FS) Orangeblossom's Un-Braided Hair Set
Author: orangeblossom7
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Un/Braided Hair Set[/b][/size]
by orangeblossom

[/center]
Hi everyone! I finally finished my hair mod pack that's been in the works for a few months now.

I love curly hairstyles, but I'm a girl with straight hair so I can only look at them longingly (getting a perm is out of the question lol + idk how to properly use the heatless curlers I recently bought)... and that is why I created this set–[b]36 hairstyles[/b] that focus on braided styles leading to curly hair, complete with [b]short, medium, and long length options [/b]to simulate hair growth. [i]I just love a little realism, okay? ( •̯́ ₃ •̯̀)[/i]

This mod is dedicated to the farmers out there with straight hair but still want to enjoy curly hairstyles while keeping a bit of realism in their game.
 
[center]❀ ❀ ❀[/center]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]short, medium, long hair lengths
[*]braided ponytail styles, braided pigtails, and unbraided hair
[*]all hairstyles are [u]recolorable![/u]
[/list]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Fashion Sense
[/list]
[b]Where to Find:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hand Mirror @ Pierre's General Store (for more info, check the Fashion Sense mod page)
[/list][i]
[/i][b]Quick Tips:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Type 'un/braided' in the search (🔍) bar in Fashion Sense to quickly access these hairs! ♡[/i]
[*][i]You can delete the hairstyles you don't want.[/i]
[/list] 
[b]
[/b][center][b]✖︎ do not redistribute ✖︎[/b][/center]
